messages.content: Help me write a post-apocalypse RPG adventure around this idea: The player characters are scavenging a corporate complex, and they encounter a pair of deactivated android replicants. These are machines programmed to act as CEOs, but only they can open up a stash of pre-War technologies.  Use only words with lengths that are prime numbers.

message.content:
The dust is thick. The air is stale. We enter the hall.

Silent forms stand still. Two metal bodies wait. They are CEOs. Their eyes are dark. No spark remains.

A lock blocks us. A key is missing. Only these machines can wake. The code is lost. The power is gone.

We must fix them. Tools are rare. Wires are frayed. Sweat drips down. Fear is high.

One unit hums. Life returns. The other stays dead. We need both. Time is short. Danger looms.

Open the door. Take the tech. Run away now.
